title: 沿空地走一个小圈
description: 成人在空旷馆内慢走，远处低墙与厚垫形成安静背景。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult walks an easy short loop around a broad uncluttered gym lounge, with one foot forward, arms relaxed, and gaze ahead. Keep the walking path on ordinary flooring outside all climbing landing zones. The low wall and continuous mats remain in the distant background, and a plain bench marks a possible rest stop. Warm light and a wide view should suggest comfortable movement without distances, times, or performance targets. Use soft chalk-pastel illustration with tactile color masses, gently smudged architecture, and lavender, muted orange, and deep blue accents. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
